The '''Dathomirian poison dart''' was a type of [[Poison dart/Legends|poison dart]] used by the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], former [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] utilized the [[Dart/Legends|dart]] to dull the senses of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] in an [[Mission to Serenno (Nightsisters)/Legends|attempt]] to exact revenge for his betrayal in the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]].<ref name="Nightsisters">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>
